subject: angol
title: Helping with an environmental project
situation: You have received this e-mail from your Scottish friend, Chloe, who is working on a school project. Write a reply in which you help her with her project.
situationHu: Skót barátnőd, Chloe, egy környezetvédelmi iskolai projekthez kér segítséget; válaszolj neki e-mailben.
stimulus:
Hi there,
I need your help! For our geography project we have to find out how young people in different countries protect the environment. What do you and your family do? Is there a big environmental problem where you live? And do you think your local council is doing enough about it? Thanks a million!
Chloe

points.text: describe what you and your family do to protect the environment
explain what the biggest environmental problem in your area is and what causes it
give your opinion on whether your local council is doing enough, with reasons

usefulPhrases.en: Happy to help with your project!
We sort our rubbish and recycle everything we can.
usefulPhrases.hu: Szelektíven gyűjtjük a szemetet, és mindent újrahasznosítunk, amit csak lehet.

usefulPhrases.en: We try to cut down on plastic.
The biggest problem around here is air pollution / illegal dumping.
usefulPhrases.hu: Itt a legnagyobb probléma a légszennyezés / az illegális szemétlerakás.

usefulPhrases.en: As far as I'm concerned, the council should …
usefulPhrases.hu: Ami engem illet, az önkormányzatnak … kellene.

usefulPhrases.en: To be fair, they have already …
Hope this helps! Good luck with the project.
usefulPhrases.hu: Remélem, segít! Sok sikert a projekthez!

modelAnswer.text:
Hi Chloe,

Happy to help with your project!

At home we sort our rubbish and recycle everything we can, and we've started taking cloth bags to the shops to cut down on plastic. My dad cycles to work whenever the weather allows, and we try not to waste food.

The biggest problem around here is air pollution, especially in winter. My town, Miskolc, lies in a valley, so the smoke from old wood-burning stoves and the fumes from heavy traffic simply can't escape.

To be fair, the council has already introduced some electric buses. However, as far as I'm concerned, it isn't doing nearly enough. Many families still burn rubbish because they can't afford modern heating, and the council offers hardly any financial support to help them switch.

Hope this helps! Good luck with the project.

Best wishes,
Dóra

My town, Miskolc, lies in a valley, so the smoke from old wood-burning stoves and the fumes from heavy traffic simply can't escape.
However, as far as I'm concerned, it isn't doing nearly enough.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: Chloe mindhárom kérdésére válaszol – a család szokásai több példával, a fő probléma (légszennyezés) és annak okai, végül indokolt vélemény az önkormányzatról, egy elismert lépéssel (elektromos buszok) és két kritikával.
Hangnem: baráti e-mail (Hi Chloe, Happy to help, Hope this helps!, Best wishes) összevont alakokkal; segítőkész és természetes, ahogy egy barátnak írnánk.
Szövegalkotás: a bekezdések sorrendje követi Chloe kérdéseit, a To be fair … However, … pár árnyalt véleményt ad, a so és a because pedig világos ok-okozati kapcsolatot teremt.
Szókincs: érdemes megtanulni: cut down on plastic, wood-burning stoves, as far as I'm concerned, hardly any financial support.
